answer.reason: Several verses tell events that happened to or in the land of Edom, such as refusing Israel passage, David's conquest and the revolt against Judah.

clauses.english: refused Israel passage through its border
clauses.quote: Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border

clauses.english: was put under garrisons by David, and its people became his servants
clauses.quote: all they of Edom became David's servants

clauses.english: revolted from under the hand of Judah and made a king of its own
clauses.quote: Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah

doubts: GEN 25:30 and GEN 36:1 concern Esau, who is called Edom, and were left out as person-verses.
The prophecies of Edom's desolation (Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Obadiah and others) were left out because they are predictions rather than events told.
The Edom verses in the lists of kings, dukes and borders only name the land, so they were not used.
